To My Special Person ❤️

Baby tumhe pata he Aaj ka din mere liye Kitna khas hai… Baby tumhe shayad pata bhi nahi, Ki tum meri zindagi me kitne khaas ho.... Kabhi kabhi main sochta hoon ki meri zindagi pehle kaisi thi, Jab se tum meri life me aai ho puri life hi change ho gai he, Tum mere liye sirf ek insaan nahi, Ek sukoon ho, Ek aadat ho, Ek khubsurat si dua ho jo har roj puri hoti hai. Tum meri zindagi ka woh khoobsurat hissa ho jise main sirf pyaar nahi karta, balki har din mehsoos karta hoon. Tumhari smile, tumhari baatein, tumhara gussa, tumhari care, tumhari choti choti aadatein, aur tumhara mere saath hona… in sab ne meri life ko ek aisi kahani bana diya jise main baar baar jeena chahta hoon. Tumhare sath baat kaarna, tumhe dekhna tumhari muskaan, Sab kuch itna normal lagta hai, Jaise zindagi isi ke liye bani ho. I don't know what future holds, But one thing I do know..... Main har haal mein tumhare saath Rahana chahta hoon --> Aaj bhi, Kal bhi, Or Parnsoo bhi, Hamesha. Thank you for being you.... Because you are my Favourite Part of this beautiful Life ❤️ I love you. ❤️

Meri Jaan… ❤️

Happy Birthday, meri jaan. ❤️

Aaj ka din sirf isliye special nahi hai kyunki aaj tumhara birthday hai.

Mere liye aaj ka din isliye special hai kyunki isi din is duniya mein woh ladki aayi thi jo ek din meri puri duniya banne wali thi.

Kabhi kabhi main sochta hoon ki agar tum meri life mein nahi aati, toh shayad meri life chal toh rahi hoti… lekin woh life meri wali life nahi hoti.

Usme woh excitement nahi hoti jo tumhara message dekh kar hoti hai. Woh smile nahi hoti jo tumhari ek chhoti si baat se automatically aa jaati hai. Woh sukoon nahi hota jo tumse baat karne ke baad milta hai.

Aur shayad mujhe kabhi pata bhi nahi chalta ki kisi ek insaan ka mere liye itna important ho jaana possible hai.

Tum meri life ka sirf ek part nahi ho.

Tum meri life ki woh jagah ho jahan main baar-baar lautna chahta hoon.

Tumse baat karna mera favourite part hai. Tumhe hasana mujhe khud khush kar deta hai.

Tum naraz hoti ho toh sach mein sab kuch thoda ajeeb sa lagne lagta hai. Tum khush hoti ho toh bina reason mera mood bhi achha ho jaata hai.

Aur jab tum mujhe apna samajh kar apni chhoti se chhoti baat batati ho na… pata nahi kyun, lekin us waqt mujhe duniya ka sabse lucky insaan hone jaisa feel hota hai.

Tumhe pata hai sabse ajeeb baat kya hai?

Ab tum meri aadat se bhi bahut aage nikal chuki ho.

Aisa lagta hai jaise tum meri rag-rag mein bas gayi ho.

Main bahar kahin hota hoon, kisi couple ko haste hue dekh leta hoon, kisi ko saath ghoomte hue dekh leta hoon, kisi ko chhoti si cheez enjoy karte hue dekh leta hoon… aur pata nahi kyun, mere dimaag mein sabse pehle tum aa jaati ho.

Main sochta hoon…

“Hum kab aise saath ghoomenge?”

“Hum kab ye sab saath enjoy karenge?”

“Kaash abhi tum bhi mere paas hoti.”

Main khush hota hoon toh tumhari yaad aati hai, kyunki mann karta hai woh khushi tumhare saath baantun.

Main udaas hota hoon toh tumhari yaad aati hai, kyunki mann karta hai tumhare paas baith jaun.

Main gusse mein hota hoon toh bhi tumhari yaad aati hai. Main thak jaata hoon toh bhi tumhari yaad aati hai.

Aur jab kabhi mujhe lagta hai ki main haar raha hoon, tab bhi mujhe tumhari hi zarurat mehsoos hoti hai.

Kyuki tum un logon mein se nahi ho jo sirf meri khushi ke time mere saath hoti ho.

Tumne mujhe meri thakaan mein bhi samjha hai. Meri haar mein bhi sambhala hai.

Mujhe jab khud par bharosa kam hua, tab tumne mujhe motivate kiya hai.

Aur shayad isi liye ab meri har feeling ka ek hissa tumse juda hua hai.

Mujhe tumhari perfect version nahi chahiye.
Mujhe tum chahiye.

Tumhari hasi. Tumhara gussa. Tumhari zid. Tumhare silly moments. Tumhari overthinking. Tumhari random baatein. Tumhara bina kisi reason ke mood change ho jaana. Tumhara care karna.

Tumhara woh tareeka jisme kabhi kabhi tum kuch bolti nahi ho, lekin phir bhi bahut kuch keh deti ho.

Mujhe ye sab chahiye. Kyuki ye sab milkar tum banti ho. Aur mujhe tumse hi pyaar hai. ❤️

Hamari story perfect nahi hai. Aur shayad mujhe perfect story chahiye bhi nahi. Mujhe hamari story chahiye.

Woh jisme hasi bhi hai. Fights bhi hain. Misunderstandings bhi hain. Pagalpan bhi hai. Long conversations bhi hain. Kabhi chhoti si baat par mood off hona bhi hai. Aur phir ek dusre ke bina zyada der reh na paana bhi hai.

Main hamari har memory ko isliye yaad nahi rakhta kyunki woh sab perfect moments the. Main unhe yaad rakhta hoon kyunki un moments mein tum thi.

Aur sach bolun toh tumhare saath ordinary moment bhi mere liye memory ban jaata hai.

Ek chhote se hello se shuru hui baat kab itni gehri ho gayi, pata hi nahi chala.

Kabhi kabhi ek normal conversation. Ek random photo. Ek chhota sa joke. Ek call. Ek “kya kar rahe ho?” Ek “khana kha liya?”

Bahar wale ke liye shayad ye sab bahut normal ho. Mere liye nahi.

Mere liye ye wahi chhoti-chhoti cheezein hain jinse meri zindagi khoobsurat bani hai.

Tumne meri life mein sirf memories nahi add ki. Tumne meri life ko mehsoos karne ka tareeka badal diya.

Tumne mujhe kisi ka wait karna sikhaya. Kisi ki awaaz miss karna sikhaya. Kisi ki smile ko apni khushi samajhna sikhaya.

Aur sabse zyada… tumne mujhe ye samjhaya ki “home” hamesha koi jagah nahi hoti.

Kabhi kabhi home ek insaan hota hai.

Aur mere liye woh insaan tum ho. ❤️

Aur ek baat jo shayad mujhe tumse aur clearly kehni chahiye…

Meri baby, mujhe pata hai ki kabhi kabhi main tumse kuch zyada hi ummeedein laga leta hoon.

Kabhi main apne dimaag mein kuch soch leta hoon… aur jab cheezein mere sochne ke hisaab se nahi hoti, toh main hurt ho jaata hoon.

Aur hurt hone ke baad kabhi kabhi main overreact kar deta hoon. Bahut kuch aisa bol deta hoon jo mujhe nahi bolna chahiye.

Kabhi tumhe bina wajah bura feel kara deta hoon. Kabhi apni expectations ko tumhari galti bana deta hoon.

Aur uske liye…

Mujhe sach mein sorry hai, meri baby.

Tumhara pyaar kisi test ka answer nahi hai. Tumhe har baar meri expectations ke according behave karna zaroori nahi hai.

Tum jo bhi dil se, apni marzi se mere liye karti ho… wahi mere liye sabse special hona chahiye. Aur main ye seekhna chahta hoon.

Main tumse ye nahi chahta ki tum meri har expectation poori karo. Main bas tumhe tumhari marzi se, tumhari khushi se, tum jaise ho waise hi pyaar karna chahta hoon.

Ab tum apni ichha se jo bhi karogi, main usi ko dil se enjoy karna chahta hoon.

Kyuki mujhe tumhari forced perfect version nahi chahiye. Mujhe meri asli wali baby chahiye.

Meri pyari chipkali. 🦞❤️

Main nahi jaanta future exactly kaisa hoga. Kaunse din easy honge. Kaunse difficult. Kitni baar hum ladenge. Kitni baar ek dusre ko samajhne mein time lagega.

Lekin ek cheez hai jo main jaanta hoon.

Main har aane wale kal mein tumhe hi choose karna chahta hoon.

Achhe dinon mein bhi. Bure dinon mein bhi. Khushi mein bhi. Tension mein bhi. Exciting days mein bhi. Boring normal days mein bhi. Jab sab kuch beautiful lage tab bhi. Aur jab sab kuch complicated lage tab bhi.

Main tumhare saath sirf best moments nahi chahta.
Main tumhare saath real life chahta hoon.

Woh life jisme normal subah ho. Late-night baatein ho. Random plans ho. Cancelled plans ho. Photos ho. Fights ho. Sorry ho. Hugs ho. Dreams ho.

Thoda gussa ho. Thodi nok-jhok ho. Kabhi tum meri khinchai karo. Kabhi main tumhari.

Aur kisi bhi problem ke baad aakhir mein hum dono fir ek dusre ke paas hi aa jaayein.

Aur raat ko din chahe jaisa bhi gaya ho…

akhir mein tum aur main ek hi ghar mein ho.

Main tumhare saath sirf ek relationship nahi chahta. Main tumhare saath apni zindagi banana chahta hoon.

Main chahta hoon ki ek din hamari dono families ek saath khadi ho. Hamari shaadi ho.

Hum dono ek dusre ko officially wohi naam de saken jo dil se shayad hum kab se de chuke hain.

Aur phir ek din… hamare paas apna ghar ho.

Aisa ghar jo sirf deewaron aur rooms se na bana ho. Aisa ghar jahan hamari family ho. Hamare apne log ho. Hamari hasi ho. Hamari nok-jhok ho. Hamari everyday life ho. Tumhara gussa ho. Mera pagalpan ho.

Sach bolun? Mujhe bahut badi-badi cheezein nahi chahiye agar tum mere saath ho.

Normal couple wali life bhi mere liye bahut special hogi…
agar usmein meri wife tum ho.

Main tumhe promise nahi kar sakta ki main hamesha perfect rahunga. Main mistakes karunga. Kabhi stupid behave karunga. Kabhi tumhe samajhne mein late karunga. Kabhi shayad bina matlab tumhe irritate bhi karunga.

Lekin ek promise main dil se kar sakta hoon.

Main hamesha try karta rahunga. Tumhe samajhne ke liye. Tumhari respect karne ke liye. Tumhare emotions ko lightly na lene ke liye. Tumhare dreams ko support karne ke liye.

Aur jab tumhe lage ki sab kuch thoda zyada bhaari ho gaya hai… tab main tumhare paas rehna chahta hoon.

Tumhari baat sunne ke liye. Tumhe sambhalne ke liye. Aur zarurat pade toh bina kuch bole sirf tumhara haath pakad kar tumhare saath khade rehne ke liye.

Tumhara dukh mera dukh hai.

Tum dukhi hoti ho toh main bhi andar se theek nahi reh pata. Tum khush hoti ho toh sach mein mujhe bhi khushi hoti hai.

Baby, tum meri jaan ho… main tumhe dukhi dekh hi nahi sakta. ❤️

Tum meri khushi mein mere saath rahi ho. Mere gham mein mere saath rahi ho. Achhe waqt mein bhi. Bure waqt mein bhi. Jab cheezein easy thi tab bhi. Aur jab sab kuch mushkil laga tab bhi.

Tumne kabhi sirf meri achhi wali version ko nahi chuna. Tum meri mushkil wali version ke saath bhi khadi rahi.

Aur shayad main tumhe jitni baar thank you bolun, woh kam hi hoga.

Thank you, meri jaan. Sirf meri wife hone ke liye nahi. Mera saath nibhane ke liye. Mujhe samajhne ke liye. Mujhe motivate karne ke liye.

Mujhe girte hue dekh kar chhod na dene ke liye. Meri khushi ko apni khushi samajhne ke liye. Mere dukh mein mere saath rehne ke liye.

Thank you mere pagalpan ko itne pyaar se jhelne ke liye… aur fir bhi mujhe apna hi samajhne ke liye. ❤️

Aur mujhe ye feel karane ke liye ki chahe bahar kitna bhi kuch chal raha ho… mere paas tum ho.

Main chahta hoon tum apni life mein bahut kuch achieve karo. Bahut travel karo. Bahut hanso. Apne saare dreams complete karo. Woh sab bano jo tum banna chahti ho.

Aur kabhi bhi apne aap ko chhota mat samajhna. Kyuki jis ladki ko main dekhta hoon na… woh bahut special hai. Bahut strong hai. Bahut khoobsurat hai. Aur woh apne aap se jitna expect karti hai na… usse kahin zyada deserve karti hai.

Aur haan… khoobsurat se mera matlab sirf tumhara chehra, tumhari smile ya tumhari photos nahi hai.

Tum khoobsurat ho tumhare komal se dil ki wajah se… jo bahut jaldi pighal jaata hai.

Tum khoobsurat ho kyunki tum chhoti-chhoti baaton ko bhi dil se feel karti ho. Tum khoobsurat ho kyunki tum care karti ho. Kyuki tumhare emotions sachche hain.

Kyuki tum bahar se chahe kitni bhi khadoos ban jao… andar se meri baby ka dil bahut hi pyara aur naram hai. ❤️

Aaj tumhara birthday hai. Aur usually birthday par log wish karte hain ki tumhari saari wishes complete ho. Main bhi wahi wish karta hoon.

Lekin thoda selfish hokar ek wish aur karta hoon.

Chahe life kitni bhi change ho jaaye… chahe kitne bhi saal beet jaayein… chahe hum dono kitne bhi bade ho jaayein… mere paas tumhe isi tarah birthday wish karne ka haq hamesha rahe.

Main har saal tumhe dekh kar keh sakun— “Happy Birthday, meri jaan.”

Aur har saal mere paas tumse pyaar karne ke aur zyada reasons ho.

Main har birthday par tumhe thoda aur achhe se samajhta rahun. Thoda aur achhe se pyaar karta rahun.

Aur har birthday par hum peeche mudkar dekhein aur bolein— “Yaar… hum kitna aage aa gaye.”

Tum meri favourite person ho. Meri favourite notification. Meri favourite awaaz. Meri favourite smile. Meri favourite memory. Aur mera favourite future.

Aur agar mujhe dobara shuru se bhi choose karna pade… toh main phir tumhe hi choose karunga.

Har baar. Bina kisi shak ke. Bina kuch soche-samjhe…

Aankhein band karun toh sabse pehle tumhara hi chehra nazar aayega.

Aur meri choice phir bhi tum hi hogi. ❤️

Thank you meri life mein aane ke liye. Thank you meri memories ka sabse beautiful part banne ke liye. Thank you meri har mushkil mein mere saath khade rehne ke liye. Aur thank you… sirf tum hone ke liye.

Happy Birthday, meri cute wife. ❤️

I love you… shayad jitna main kabhi words mein properly bata hi nahi paunga.

Aur shayad isi liye maine ye poora experience banaya. Kyuki tumhare liye ek simple “Happy Birthday” kabhi enough tha hi nahi.

Tum mere liye simple nahi ho. Tum special ho. Bahut zyada.

Aur agar kabhi tumhe lage ki tum mere liye kitni important ho… toh ye poori website dobara dekh lena.

Har photo. Har memory. Har game. Har line. Har chhota sa detail.

Kyuki in sabke peeche ek hi reason tha— tum.

Jo kuch peeche tha woh hamari kahani hai… aur jo aage hai… use bhi main tumhare saath hi jeena chahta hoon.

Ye story yahin khatam nahi hoti. Abhi toh humne bas kuch memories banayi hain. Baaki poori life padi hai.

Aur main chahta hoon ki usmein jitni bhi khushiyan aayein… main tumhare saath baantun. Jitna bhi dukh aaye… usmein tumhare paas rahun.

Jahan bhi jaun… wahan tumhari yaad ke bajay ek din tum khud mere paas ho.

“Kaash tum bhi yahan hoti…”

toh ek din mujhe ye line bolne ki zarurat hi na pade.

Kyuki tum sach mein mere saath ho. Meri wife. Meri partner. Meri best friend. Mera ghar. Meri aadat. Mera sukoon.

Aur… Meri pyari chipkali. 🦞❤️

Bas ek baat hamesha yaad rakhna—

chahe main kitna bhi gussa karun, kitni bhi ulta-seedhi baatein bol dun, kabhi bina matlab zyada react kar jaun, ya hum dono kitna bhi lad lein…

ek baat kabhi mat sochna ki mere dil mein tumhari jagah kam ho gayi hai.

Gussa thodi der ka ho sakta hai. Ladai thodi der ki ho sakti hai. Narazgi bhi thodi der ki ho sakti hai.

Lekin tumhari jagah?

Woh mere dil mein wahi rahegi.

Kyuki ek ladai, ek galat baat ya ek bura din mere tumhare liye pyaar ko chhota nahi kar sakta. ❤️

I Always Love You. ❤️

Main seekhunga. Main improve karunga. Main galtiyan bhi karunga.

Lekin ek cheez nahi badlegi— main tumhara saath chhodna nahi chahta.

Main tumhare saath dheere-dheere aur achha insaan banna chahta hoon. Tumhare saath seekhna chahta hoon. Tumhare saath apni galtiyan sudharna chahta hoon.

Aur zindagi ke har naye mod par tumhara haath pakad kar aage badhna chahta hoon.

Tumhare saath ghar banana chahta hoon. Tumhare saath family ke beech rehna chahta hoon. Tumhare saath normal boring din bhi jeena chahta hoon. Tumhare saath buddha hona chahta hoon.

Aur meri bas ek chhoti si khwahish aur hai… ki aaj se bahut saare birthdays beet jaayein, hum dono ki zindagi kitni bhi badal jaaye, hum kitne bhi bade ho jaayein… phir bhi jab main tumhe dekhun na, toh mere dil mein wahi feeling aaye jo aaj aati hai.

Wahi pyaar. Wahi apnapan.

Wahi “ye meri wali hai” wali feeling. ❤️

Bas tab farq sirf itna ho… ki tab tum sirf meri yaadon mein nahi, mere saamne, mere ghar mein, meri zindagi mein mere saath ho.

Happy Birthday, meri pyari chipkali. ❤️

Hamesha tumhara. ❤️
